# Janet

## Overview

- **Age:** forty  <sub>[v3 ch.Last P51](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0051)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Janet is a nice-looking, stoutish woman who is tall without being over-tall. She has a sunny face with rosy cheeks, big kind eyes as blue as forget-me-nots, and soft, crimpy brown hair featuring a thread of gray, which she wears in a knot.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Philippa P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001)_

## History

Janet Sweet was a pleasant landlady living at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside) in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) who lost her sister [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when her sister was young. For twenty years, she was courted by a quiet admirer named [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md), who visited her regularly without ever proposing. After being encouraged by her boarder [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to take a stand, Janet briefly rejected John's escort after a prayer meeting, though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) quickly intervened to reconcile them. Following the death of John's mother, John proposed to Janet and explained that he had been bound by a secret promise to his mother to wait until her passing before he could marry.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Philippa P0](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0000), [v3 ch.Philippa P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 ch.Philippa P2](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0002), [v3 ch.Philippa P8](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0008), [v3 ch.Philippa P9](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0009), [v3 ch.Douglas P0](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0000), +11 more_

## Quotes

> "If she wasn’t—but she is. So we mustn’t speak evil of her. But I’m happy at last, Anne. And I wouldn’t have minded waiting so long a bit if I’d only known why."
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Last P47](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0047)

> "Oh, she does. She’s told me time and again that she’d love to see John settled before her time comes. She’s always giving him hints—you heard her yourself the other day. I thought I’d ha’ gone through the floor."
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Coming” P10](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0010)

> “I couldn’t,” said poor Janet pathetically. “You see, Anne, I’ve always been awful fond of John. He might just as well keep coming as not, for there was never anybody else I’d want, so it didn’t matter.”
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Coming” P13](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0013)

> "No, I guess not. I was afraid to try, anyway, for fear he’d think I meant it and just go. I suppose I’m a poor-spirited creature, but that is how I feel. And I can’t help it."
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Coming” P16](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0016)

> “I dunno,” said Janet hopelessly. “I dunno if I could ever get up enough spunk. Things have drifted so long. But I’ll think it over.”
>
> — Janet — [v3 ch.Coming” P18](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0018)

## Relationships

### [John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/janet--john-douglas.md)

[John Douglas](../character/john-douglas.md) is Janet's long-time quiet admirer and beau, though their romance was held back for twenty years because his mother forced him to promise he would not marry or speak of it until after her death. Although Janet grew frustrated by the endless delay and briefly rejected his company at Anne's urging, John was heartbroken by the rift. Shortly after his mother's passing, John immediately proposed to Janet and explained the reason for his long silence.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Douglas P0](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0000), [v3 ch.Douglas P5](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0005), [v3 ch.Douglas P8](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0008), +10 more_

- Romantically involved with — courting / beau  <sub>[v3 ch.Douglas P8](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0008)</sub>
